official_definition: You can reveal three cards from each player's decktop. Both players return those cards to their decktop, face-up. While there are face-up cards in deck, when drawing via an effect, only one card can be drawn. (Effects that target decktop start below the face-up cards, and cards that return to the decktop return to the deck below the face-up cards.)

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Draw Lock] or [Draw Lock: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Draw Lock]", "give [Draw Lock]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
